about.title: What is Copor
about.body: Copor is an airsoft club dedicated to tactical play, field discipline, and camaraderie. We regularly run trainings and operations, work on gear and tactics, and are always looking for new members who share the same passion for airsoft.
about.card1Body: A symbol of leadership and instinct — the wolf head as our team's mark.
about.card2Body: Focus on the target, tactics, and continuous improvement.
about.card3Body: Team, discipline, and trust — above all else.
rules.title: Rulebook
rules.intro: Our trainings and operations are based on the Serbian Airsoft Rulebook (SASP) and the supplements used at events run by the wider airsoft community, plus rules specific to our club. Below is a summary of the most important safety rules — full rules are explained before every event.
rules.eyewearBody: Eye protection/mask must be worn on the field at all times and never removed, no matter the circumstances.
rules.hitBody: A hit to any part of the body, gear, or replica (including from a teammate) counts — only ricochets don't count, and a BB that passes through branches does count as a hit. The player lowers their replica, calls out loudly, puts on a kill rag (a 40×40 cm fluorescent orange/red cloth), and heads to spawn by the shortest route without talking to active players.
rules.blindfireBody: Firing without looking at your target (around a corner, over cover, while running) is strictly forbidden. All automatic fire (full auto, burst) is banned — single shots only. The only exception is the LMG, which may fire full auto.
rules.disputeBody: Every disputed situation is resolved against yourself, with no arguing on the field. Fair play comes before everything else.
rules.substancesBody: Alcohol is allowed. Consuming psychoactive substances before or during an event is strictly forbidden.
rules.energyBody: Pistols, shotguns, and assault replicas up to 1.49 J (400 fps) with no MED; LMG up to 1.88 J (450 fps), 20 m MED; DMR up to 2.32 J (500 fps), 20 m MED; sniper up to 3.34 J (600 fps), 30 m MED. Speeds apply to 0.20 g BBs, and chronographing is mandatory before play starts.
fields.title: Fields we play on
fields.intro: We regularly play and train on fields across southern Serbia — from Niš to Vranje. Open a field in Google Maps for its exact location and directions.
fields.cta: Have a field to suggest, or run an airsoft venue? Reach out via the contact section below.
team.title: Team
team.intro: Copor brings together players of different roles and experience levels — from assaulters to precision shooters. Members are listed in alphabetical order. Click a member to open their loadout, and an item to see a picture of it.
team.role1Body: Front line, fast advances, and taking positions.
team.role2Body: Covering the team with fire and holding lines at range.
team.role3Body: Watching the field and calling out enemy positions in time.

replicas.title: Our replicas
replicas.intro: The replica classes we play with — from M4/AR and AK assault platforms to support and precision replicas. Every replica is chronographed before play and has to stay within its class limits; automatic fire is allowed only for the LMG.
replicas.assaultBody: M4/AR and AK platforms for short- and mid-range play.
replicas.lmgBody: Light machine guns for covering the team and holding lines — the only class allowed full auto.
replicas.dmrBody: Precision replicas with at least a 4× optic and at least 1 s between shots.
replicas.sniperBody: Replicas for the longest engagements, with a mandatory optic of at least 4× or an LPVO.
replicas.pistolBody: Sidearm — mandatory alongside LMG, DMR, and sniper replicas for engagements under the MED.
replicas.shotgunBody: Replicas for close-range and indoor (CQB) fights.

pravilnikPage.title: Serbian Airsoft Rulebook (SASP)
pravilnikPage.intro: This is a summary of the rules that apply at our club's trainings and operations, based on the Serbian Airsoft Rulebook (SASP) and the supplements used by the wider airsoft community. The goal is safe, fair, and team-oriented play for everyone.
pravilnikPage.eyewearBody: Eye protection or a mask is worn on the field at all times and never removed, no matter the circumstances.
pravilnikPage.substancesBody: Alcohol is allowed. Consuming psychoactive substances immediately before or during an event is strictly forbidden.
pravilnikPage.arrivalBody: Don't arrive at an event already wearing military or police uniforms, or Ministry of Interior (MUP) or Ministry of Defence insignia. Replicas are carried on safe with no magazine, in a bag or case, until play begins.
pravilnikPage.hitBody: A hit to any part of the body, gear, or replica — including from a teammate — counts. The player lowers their replica, calls out loudly, puts a kill rag (a 40×40 cm fluorescent orange or red cloth) in plain view, and leaves the field by the shortest route without talking to active players. Night games use a glowing kill rag (a red light near the head or shoulder).
pravilnikPage.blindfireBody: Firing without looking at your target (around a corner, over cover, while running) is strictly forbidden. "Bang bang" doesn't count — the opponent has to be actually hit by a BB.
pravilnikPage.fireModeBody: All automatic fire — full auto and burst — is banned for every replica. Only single (semi-auto) fire is allowed: one shot per trigger pull. The only exception is the LMG, which may fire full auto.
pravilnikPage.specialHitsBody: When two players hit each other in practically the same instant (a cross kill), both leave the game. A silent kill is a light touch with a hand or a training melee replica, with no call-out — the victim quietly displays their kill rag. Only a ricochet (a deflected BB) doesn't count as a hit — a BB that passes through branches or foliage does count.
pravilnikPage.disputeBody: Every disputed situation is resolved against yourself, with no arguing on the field. If someone won't acknowledge a hit, call yourself out and take it to a marshal.
pravilnikPage.conductBody: Targeting civilians (photographers, bystanders) or animals is forbidden. BBs are not picked up off the ground, and litter goes only in designated bins. Only certified smoke grenades are allowed — no pyrotechnics.
pravilnikPage.energyTitle: Replica energy and minimum engagement distance (MED)
pravilnikPage.energyIntro: Energy (J), the matching speed with 0.20 g BBs (fps), and minimum engagement distance (MED) by replica class. Chronographing (using only 0.20 g BBs) is mandatory before play starts. Automatic fire is allowed only for the LMG.
pravilnikPage.noteLmg: The only class allowed full auto; firing only from a standing, kneeling, or prone position
pravilnikPage.noteDmr: Single shots only, min. 1 s between shots, ≥4× optic
pravilnikPage.energyFoonote: Players carrying long replicas (LMG/DMR/sniper) must also carry a sidearm for engagements under the prescribed MED.
pravilnikPage.grenadesBody: Only certified airsoft grenades are allowed. A grenade's effect applies within a 5 m radius — a player in that range calls themselves out even without a direct BB hit, unless they're fully out of the blast's line of sight.
pravilnikPage.lightsBody: Flashlights up to 2000 lumens are allowed. Lasers and laser aiming devices (PEQ) are not. A red filter is reserved for the night kill rag.
pravilnikPage.shieldsBody: Only shields that faithfully represent a real model are allowed, weighing at least 25% of the original. A shield carrier is limited to a sidearm or one-handed SMG replica.
pravilnikPage.dronesBody: Drones and RC vehicles are allowed for recon only — engaging them is forbidden. Real bladed weapons and firearms are strictly forbidden; only a small knife or multitool is allowed on the field as a tool.
pravilnikPage.source: This summary is based on the Serbian Airsoft Rulebook (SASP) and the rulebook used at Beoshot community events in Železnik — full source rulebook (PDF). Where the rules on this page differ from the source rulebook, the rules on this page apply at Copor trainings and operations. Each event's organizer may add extra or stricter rules, explained before play begins.

alliesPage.intro: Airsoft is stronger when clubs support each other — allied teams are the crews we regularly train with, trade experience with, and show up to events alongside.
alliesPage.join: Represent a club we could team up with? Reach out via the contact section.
aszJugPage.title: ASZ JUG — Airsoft Community South
aszJugPage.intro: ASZ JUG (Airsoft zajednica jug / Airsoft Community South) is a regional community of airsoft teams from southern Serbia, founded in 2023.
aszJugPage.about1: ASZ JUG is an alliance of independent teams, not a club above the clubs. Every team keeps its own name, insignia and way of working — what they share is what makes the game safe and fair: the same safety standard, the same minimum set of rules, and an agreement to run the big operations together.
aszJugPage.about2: In practice that means a coordinated calendar, fields open to every member team, marshals and kit lent back and forth, help for new teams finding their feet, and larger games organised jointly that no single team could put on alone.
aszJugPage.about3: The community's crest carries a double-headed eagle, the ASZ JUG mark and the founding year — 2023.
aszJugPage.patchBody: This is the crest as the woven patch worn on the uniform: an olive field, a grey band carrying the lettering, the Serbian tricolour beneath it, red and blue corners, and a dark merrowed edge.
aszJugPage.foundersTitle: The teams that founded ASZ JUG in 2023
aszJugPage.foundersIntro: The community was founded in 2023 by eleven teams from southern Serbia. Copor is one of them.
aszJugPage.correction: If something here is wrong, or a founder's link is missing, let us know through the contact section and we'll fix it.
